Game Overview

Mall Anomaly is a casual title where navigate eerie corridors where mannequins fixate and furniture defies gravity. Uncover anomalies in this twisted mall before it spirals into a glitchy abyss. It's like a haunted "spot the difference," where each discovery staves off chaos a little longer. Can you save the mall from its bizarre meltdown?
